<STBG 5,0><BGM 0,0,504><MWT 5>The deciphering of the tablet about
the <COL FEEB4EFF>treasure of Tripuu Island</COL> is complete,
so I record it here.

<MWT 4>"The vessel that weaves the stars;
 the scent of incense crosses the stars
 and points the road we take"

<MWT 4>Pointing the way...
Could it divine our future too?
